# Muse Connector Template

Fork it, point it at your own service, deploy to Vercel, Cloudflare Workers or Docker: you get per-connection tokens, async-job scaffolding, and OpenAPI plus llms.txt generated from a single registry, so a Muse connector comes out correct by construction. Note: this deploys a working skeleton with placeholder operations, not a finished connector — it is a starting point for developers.
